findings.title: Firmware rule 3 gives Q124's gate time constant as 47–53 µs; with the fitted C126's +10 % tolerance it reaches about 58–61 µs
findings.contradicts: The fitted C126 is Samsung CL10B224KA8NNNC (JLC BOM m3_bom_jlc.csv line 15, C21120; tools/verified_part_metadata.json), tolerance code K = ±10 % (Samsung MLCC part-numbering guide, cached .supervisor/r14_parts_pdf/samsung.pdf p. 4, '5. TOLERANCE CODE ... K = 10%'; parts_qualification.md:34 and :521 also call C21120 '220 nF X7R ±10%'). The statement's own source, round23_safety_severity_check.md:68 (and .json 'value': '47-50 (C126 -10 % + Ciss), 53.0 nominal'), computed only the −10 % and nominal cases; the generated text and the docs present 47–53 µs as the gate time constant without that qualifier.
findings.evidence: Board a0ec075e (pcbnew dump): PYRO1_GATE_N = {U1.3, R126.1, R127.1}; PYRO1_GATE = {R126.2, R128.1, C126.1, Q124.4, TP122.1}; R126 220 Ω, R127 1 kΩ, R128 10 kΩ, C126 220 nF (C126.2 GND). Source model (round23_safety_severity_check.md:68-76): drivers ≤ 50 Ω, Ciss 2.25 nF (AON7524 Rev 1.1 p2); Thevenin R = (220 + (50∥50∥1000)) ∥ 10000 = 238.6 Ω. τ = R × (C126 + Ciss): −10 % 200.25 nF → 47.8 µs; nominal 222.25 nF → 53.0 µs (both reproduce the source); +10 % 244.25 nF → 58.3 µs. Over the source's driver range (source 18.4–35.5 Ω) the ±10 % envelope is 46.6–60.9 µs (script .supervisor/r29_mcu, Calculation). Stated as '47–53 µs' in: generated rule 3 (r10_binding_note.json firmware_obligations[38], SHA 30796f5e…, from m3_design/r10_sch_check.py:366), docs/M3_R10.md:1095, docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md:39, docs/R10_VALIDATION.md:2561. Regenerating the note on a probe copy reproduces the committed file byte for byte, so the generator is the origin.
findings.impact: Text and record only. A larger τ only slows the gate, so the rule's safety conclusions (fire after about 0.55 ms of a sustained fight; ≤ 6 mA RMS at ≥ 25 MHz logging) stay conservative; no procedure or check uses the figure. The range as written is still false for a board whose C126 sits in the upper half of its tolerance.
findings.concrete_fix: In r10_sch_check.py:366 (regenerate the binding note and update the pinned string in tools/test_r10_check.py if it pins it), M3_R10.md:1095, FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md:39 and R10_VALIDATION.md:2561, replace 'the gate time constant is 47–53 µs' with 'the gate time constant is about 47–61 µs over C126's ±10 % (53 µs nominal; Calculation, driver resistances Inference)', or keep '47–53 µs' and qualify it as 'from C126 at −10 % to nominal (53 µs; about 58–61 µs at +10 %)'. No board change.

Binding note regenerated by r10_sch_check.py --binding-note on a probe copy of assembly_review: byte-identical to the committed note (SHA 30796f5e…); board / netlist / pin-table / circuit hashes in it match the files; test_r23_binding_note_rules_and_pin_table passes.

Rule 3 meter check re-derived: R127.1 to GND = 1 kΩ ∥ (220 Ω + 10 kΩ) = 910.9 Ω (R127 C11702 1 %); red lead on R127.1 forward-biases the GND-side clamps of U1.1 (PE2) and U3.3; a meter whose open-circuit voltage cannot forward-bias them reads open, which the criterion also passes; a U1.1-U1.3 bridge reads near 0 Ω both ways and fails. No polarity or parallel-path flaw left.

Rule 4 criterion re-derived: ACT_GATE = {C120.2, Q120.4, Q121.4, R119.1, R120.2, R121.1}; settled |VGS| = V(ACT_FET_S) x (R119∥R120)/(R119∥R120 + R121) = 0.833 x; with both gate vias (16.2,73.3)/(15.4,72.85) removed on a probe copy, R120.2 / C120.2 / Q120.4 form one island and R119.1 / R121.1 / Q121.4 the other, so probing R120.2 against R120.1 (ACT_FET_S, B(18.5,72.17)) sees the cut-off gate at about 0 V as stated; AONR21357 VSD 0.7 / 1.0 V at 1 A (p2) and RDS(on) <= 12.3 mOhm at -4.5 V make the 0.2 V BAT_IN - RAW_ACT line discriminating.

Rule 4's '0.93-1.01x the 1.125 A floor' spans the source table's variants (incl. the -20 C Inference case 1.043 A and Q120's 0.04 Ohm removed 1.137 A), slightly wider than 1.063/1.128 A alone give (0.945-1.003x); a bound, not a false ratio.

Pull-up arithmetic re-run: PE4 node 0.106 V / gate 0.104 V and Q122 gate 0.218 V against a 30 kOhm pull-up at 3.6 V; PC1 high 2.2 V / 1.1 mA; PC8 2.20 V at 4.4 V vs VIH 0.7 VDD = 2.31 V (Table 157); PA3 0.825 V; scales PA6 /11, PB1 /11, PC0/PC5 /11.2; IWDG 960 LSI cycles 28.571-32.653 ms, fault bound 34.853 ms; PA6 window 0.44-0.47 V x 11 = 4.84-5.17 V.

U4 / U5 pins: U4 SDO/CS/SCL/SDA on SPI1_MISO/IMU_CS/SPI1_SCK/SPI1_MOSI, INT1 on PE1, SDx/SCx to GND, OCS_aux/SDO_aux/INT2 unconnected; U5 PS = 3V3A and CSB = GND (I2C, 0x77), SDA/SCL on PB9/PB8 with R13/R12 4.7 kOhm; U4 at B(17,45.9) rotation 180, lever arm x -6 mm.

Table 120 (p213) gives PA4 / PA5 an injected-current limit of -0/0 mA; both are TT pins driven only by 3V3 pull-ups (R91, R89) and open-drain outputs (TPS2121 ST, TPS25947 FLT), so no stated path injects; not stated in the docs and not needed by any requirement.
